Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that WebSurfer had found “Pine Springs, Minnesota” (Washington County) despite the visible search result indicating “Pine Springs, Texas” in Culberson County. This unfounded assumption misinterpreted the evidence, risking an incorrect county seat (Stillwater) instead of the correct answer (Van Horn).
